name: Ruby
description: Code intelligence for Ruby projects using their own Ruby and gems.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings as you type, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in Ruby files. The language server starts when a Ruby file opens in a project and stops when none are open. It uses the project’s Ruby and gems. Gode installs ruby-lsp separately, leaving your gems untouched.
failed: The Ruby language server could not start.
missing: Install Ruby and RubyGems to use the Ruby language server.
tooOld: The Ruby language server needs Ruby 3.0 or newer. Install a newer Ruby and make it the one on your PATH.
